audit_metadata.grade_rationale: 3 P1 findings exceed the C threshold (max_p1=2). Two RCE-class CVEs in infrastructure plus a raw-SQL architecture violation (injection risk) in a live route handler.

escalations.title: Raw SQL executed directly in route handler — injection risk
escalations.detail: db.prepare()/.run() calls live directly inside Express route handlers with no service-layer abstraction. If any parameter is caller-controlled, this is an injection surface. Architecture rule explicitly prohibits this pattern.
escalations.fix: Extract teamDispatchService.ts; route delegates to service; service owns all db.prepare() calls.

escalations.title: Arbitrary Code Execution in protobufjs (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs to >=7.5.6 in platform/orchestrator

escalations.title: JavaScript Injection in handlebars (CVSS 9.8) — conditional
escalations.note: Verify whether handlebars is actually installed as a transitive dep before escalating. If present, upgrade to >=4.7.9.
escalations.fix: Run: cd Source/Backend && npm ls handlebars — if present, npm audit fix

escalations.title: esbuild Binary Integrity Missing / Build-Time RCE (CVSS 8.1)
escalations.detail: Exploitable via NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY env swap. Affects CI/CD supply chain.
escalations.fix: Enforce npm ci with locked lockfile in CI; upgrade vite to pull esbuild >=0.28.1

backlog.title: Raw SQL in route handler — no service layer
backlog.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/services/teamDispatchService.ts; move all db.prepare()/.run() calls into the service; route handler calls service only.

backlog.title: protobufjs RCE (CVSS 9.8) in platform/orchestrator
backlog.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs

backlog.title: handlebars JavaScript Injection (CVSS 9.8) — conditional
backlog.recommendation: Verify with: npm ls handlebars in Source/Backend. If present, npm audit fix.

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ — false gate results

backlog.title: portal/Shared/api.ts missing blocked_by?: string[] on update types

backlog.title: portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts missing — FR-dependency-seed unimplemented
backlog.recommendation: Implement seed.ts with dependency relationship fixtures as required by FR-dependency-seed.

backlog.title: DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx absent

backlog.title: esbuild Build-Time RCE / supply chain (CVSS 8.1)
